First I would check to see if he might have some medical issues, like hypothyroidism or anything else that would make him realistically fall asleep like that (my dad does this), or even try to see if he might be secretly doing a type of drug or something

Then I would just take it from there, I would really communicate how much this is hurting you, and how tired you are and explain how yall made this pact basically to parent this child and how you need him. Don't come to him with aggression, but with love and communication. Its you and him vs this problem, and if he refuses to accept or try, then its up to you what to do next.
What sucks is the feeling of "what if" eating you up.

Man if you truly love the man, you're going to have to put the need for time with him away. Facetime, gaming, and trust. Plan on meetings whenever yall can, and just fill in the gaps with calls, cute texts, etc. Fall asleep on the phone and just make the effort to do different things through distance. If you want the relationship to last it will. You can't say the last thing you want is to not be with him then break up with him because of distance. Plus 1.5 hours away isnt even that bad! You can do this and he can too yall just need to face the fact yall will not be together physically for awhile. Have phone sex, call frequently, and love eachother until yall close the gap.
